newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hazelton says has hesitant Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hazelton says has hesitant Sept qtr.

text.p: Regional carrier Hazelton Airlines Ltd said on Friday it had a hesitant first quarter to September 30 but was now seeing signs of improving passenger demand.
Hazelton chairman Sir Brian Massey-Greene told shareholders at the company's annual meeting that directors had indicated in early September that business conditions had been hestitant.

"Along with other regional carriers in New South Wales we have found that this hesitancy has continued during the first quarter of 1996/97," Massey-Greene said. Hazelton reported a net loss of A$2.46 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
"Passenger numbers have been slightly above budget, however, but due to a number of factors yield has suffered," Massey-Greene said.
"We are, however, now seeing signs of improving passenger demand," he said.
"October has been stronger and our forward bookings indicate a continuation of that improved level of demand," he added.
At 11.30 p.m. (0030 GMT), Hazelton shares were steady at A$1.20.
